I had in mind that it would be better to have the whole release process happen on master. Something like that:

 0. check if on develop
 1. move to master 
 2. build stuff etc.
 3. publish, tag, etc.
 4. merge back to develop

I've updated the flow, it is the following:

1. check if you are on branch develop
2. git checkout master
3. pull and merge develop into master
4. build, tag, commit on master and publish to npm
5. merge back master into develop and push develop
6. checkout develop

title: chore(release): allow releases from develop
